verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at docs.lambda.ai/llms.txt), and nothing in the evidence shows Lambda publishing agent-oriented documentation. The keyless OpenAPI spec is a machine-readable API reference, an adjacent developer building block rather than agent-oriented docs. The MCP server and CLI that let agents manage instances are unofficial third-party community tools, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
